{"id":"persona-vvs2.1","title":"Add a Windows CI leg covering persona-core","description":"persona-core builds and tests on Windows today: zero Unix-only source, no libc dependency, and all eight dependencies are cross-platform.

Add a windows-latest job running 'cargo build -p persona-core' and 'cargo test -p persona-core'. Do NOT widen it to the workspace: persona-attestors, persona-grpc and the three binaries are Unix-only and would fail immediately, giving a permanently red gate that everyone learns to ignore.

What this buys is narrow and worth having: it prevents persona-core drifting Unix-ward unnoticed. Someone adds libc or std::os::unix to the crate holding the crypto and the pseudonym derivation, and today nothing notices until a Windows port begins. It also needs no protoc, since persona-core has no build script.

Widen the leg one crate at a time as the transport abstraction lands.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"task","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-09-14T05:14:38.197146303Z","created_by":"agent","updated_at":"2026-09-14T05:14:38.197146303Z","labels":["windows","ci","portability"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"persona-vvs2.1","depends_on_id":"persona-vvs2","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-09-14T05:14:38.228492061Z","created_by":"agent","metadata":"{}"},{"issue_id":"persona-vvs2.1","depends_on_id":"persona-vvs2.2","type":"supersedes","created_at":"2026-09-15T16:38:40.372324676Z","created_by":"agent","metadata":"{}"}]}
